metadata.description: Claude Code plugins: a Nuxt 4 website foundation and a model-tiered dev crew.

plugins.name: web-foundation
plugins.description: Nuxt 4 website foundation: a runnable template plus skills to scaffold projects and add resources, realtime, assistant, PWA and deploy.

plugins.name: dev-crew
plugins.description: A crew of subagents for big coding tasks and for analysing large bodies of code or docs: each role on the model suited to it (plan and review on Fable or Opus, develop on Sonnet, verify on Haiku), git worktrees per area for code, every decision written to docs.
